exam: 112年公務人員高等考試三級考試暨普通考試
subject: 觀光英語
classes: 觀光行政(選試觀光英語)

essays.text: 英譯中：Translate the following passage into Chinese（30分）The Christmas markets in Germany in December, by far, draw the biggestcrowds, attracting millions of people each year. From Christmas music andholiday treats and regional handicrafts, there is something to please everyone.The markets date back several centuries and historically have offered seasonalgoods from local merchants. Visitors today can still find traditional items in thesame authentic settings. Historically, Christmas markets lasted only a numberof days. Today, however, most markets begin at the end of November and lastuntil Christmas Eve.
中譯英：Translate the following passage into English（30分）如果你想向別人介紹臺灣的美麗、文化及美食，你會帶他們去那裡呢？南臺灣有一處旅遊天堂，應有盡有。這個地方就是屏東縣，此地的陽光和海浪邀你擁抱最美好的臺灣。你可以前往墾丁國家公園，許多熱愛陽光及潛水的人，都深受其漂亮的白沙灘、珊瑚礁及各式水上活動所吸引。

英文作文：Write an English essay in 250-300 words（40分）The night markets in Taiwan are highly recognized internationally, attractingmillions of tourists from all over the world for visiting every year. Pleasedescribe two of the night markets to the potential tourists from overseas aboutwhy they are so fascinating, and are the must to visit.
